data.title: Musterbank: account fee rising to €6.90, your consent needed
data.summary: Musterbank eG wants to raise the monthly account fee for your Girokonto Klassik from €4.90 to €6.90 from 1 December 2026. It needs your explicit consent, requested by 30 November 2026.
data.explanation: Your bank plans to raise the monthly fee for your current account from €4.90 to €6.90 from 1 December 2026. Silence does not count as consent, so the bank must get your explicit agreement, either in online banking or with the signed reply form. If you don't agree, the bank says it may terminate the account with two months' notice. You may also close the account yourself at any time free of charge. You can decide whether to consent, switch to another account, or ask about the free "Start" model for people in education up to age 27. The app shows any cancellation window it calculates.
